title: Carry live skill data into F-130-T10 and document the endpoint
goal: The Angular migration keeps the live skills panel, and the endpoint is documented
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "y" to the skills panel and pre-flight skill plan (earlier: "pre flight check, ok", real data).

F-130-T10's acceptance gains a line: the Angular skills panel reads GET /api/skills and keeps the stage tabs and the empty state (test across the endpoint and the component); F-130-T10 stays planned and its estimate is re-reviewed
The README/operator documentation lists GET /api/skills and the empty-state command; docs/test-capability-index.md names the join test
privacy: Neutral invented skills, fleets, spots and weather only; no owner data, tokens or coordinates of a real place in Git or tests.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: two documentation edits. Not a measurement.
